summary: VivoSim Labs filed an 8-K disclosing a private placement with an institutional investor. The company issued pre-funded warrants to purchase 4,705,883 shares and common warrants for the same number of shares at a combined purchase price of $0.85 per underlying share, raising ~$4.0M gross. The pre-funded warrants have a nominal exercise price of $0.001; common warrants are exercisable at $0.85 per share pending stockholder approval. Proceeds will fund working capital. The company agreed to a 60-day standstill on certain equity issuances. This is a capital-raising transaction (a PIPE) that returns capital to the company. Watch for Nasdaq notification and any stockholder meeting for warrant approval.
